# DropSpace v0.3.2-beta.5 — Restore widget editing and remove the test DLC listing

<!-- update-summary: Restores drag-based widget layout editing without row/column numeric inputs, preserves queued resize and Undo fixes, and removes the internal sample module from public DLC distribution. -->

v0.3.2-beta.4 is the immediate upgrade baseline for this release.

- Removes the reintroduced widget row/column NumberBoxes and restores the Beta 3 interaction: drag to position, drag back to the library to remove, and shape buttons to resize.
- Preserves Beta 4 position retention during queued resizing, Undo snapshots and asynchronous error ownership.
- Removes the internal `dropspace.sample` lifecycle/UI fixture from the online and bundled DLC catalogs and prevents its registration for future public distribution. Its historical Release is retained as a recoverable draft; installed user data and real DLC capabilities are preserved.

## Validation scope

The preceding repair turn passed two focused source-linked drag/resize scenarios and a targeted editor compilation. Those checks are reused, not rerun. This release requires complete Release App/XAML compilation, exact-main packaging, the existing single installer-payload scenario and required security/resource/runtime/version/hash/update integrity gates. Optional functional, visual, broad and stress tests are skipped.

Native Windows drag input, actual Undo button clicks and full visual/upgrade lifecycle coverage are not claimed. Historical failures and model limitations remain recorded. Settings, update channels, signing/deployment policy and model/CUDA bytes are unchanged; optional AI remains experimental and off by default.

See the [release record](https://github.com/airanluo-dot/DropSpace/blob/main/docs/dev/beta5-release-2026-10-18.md).
